headline: Battle Lines Stir Across Divided Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns show the campaign’s ownership ledger still turning chiefly in divided sectors, though the tempo has shifted since the previous edition. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest front at 61 base events over 24 hours, with six Colonial, one Warden, and two neutral holdings, but no event in the latest two-hour window; Palantine Berm likewise has 51 daily events, five Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base, yet no fresh two-hour movement. Stlican Shelf has quickened, posting two events in the latest two hours and 25 across the day, while its map stands at seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral holding. Callahan’s Passage remains a costly furnace, with three recent events, 29 daily events, and all ten bases Warden-held. Stonecradle records 11 daily events and three in six hours, with eight Colonial, one Warden, and no neutral base. Elsewhere, Kuura Strand’s 11-event day has gone quiet, while Nevish Line, Dead Lands, and several casualty-heavy sectors show little immediate base movement. The next edition’s decisive clues lie in these contested ledgers, not the silent fronts.
